brief: Owner message 2026-10-18 (Italian): PEE must distinguish a product function or capability (auto mode, night mode, sensor-based control), a component with a capability (PM2.5 sensor, filter), an operating mode or setting (speed 1/2/3, often ordinal; sleep; nominal values), a test condition, a performance metric defined by a method (CADR, sound level with method and conditions), a measurement result (a metric's value under conditions, e.g. noise in night mode) and an expert qualitative observation, linked by typed, verifiable first-order relations. Function presence is categorical (available / not available / not verified) and never evidence of effectiveness. Speed 1, Sleep and Lowest are not synonyms without proof. The qualitative model must not become a container for everything without a unit. Framed as an engineering question, not a new architecture.
registeredBefore: any code of the typed fact layer (fc.1); the reference is annotated and sealed first
dataClass: 9 reference pages (5 categories: air purifiers 5, dehumidifiers 1, tumble dryers 1, dishwashers 1, air fryers 1), already retained and spent for tables or attribution in earlier phases; their function, mode and component content has not been inspected by the developer in this work and will not be before the first run. Development evidence, never held-out. 4 development pages (air purifiers 2, dishwashers 1, air fryers 1) may be read by the developer. The 7 KV pages are regression data only. Zero HTTP.
reference: 3 fresh-context annotators (same model family: frozen, not author-independent), one per page group, from a neutral Chromium rendering (JavaScript off, network blocked). Types: function (presence, sensor-based, stated by, effectiveness in the same statement), component (enables), mode (scale, ordinal position, stated equivalence only when the page says it), result under a mode or setting (metric, value, conditions by kind, basis), function_performance (what, evidence, polarity). Sealed in freeze.json (gold, prompt and input hashes).

arms.base: the current readers at b49f8b0 (wd.1 + qe.1 + 1G tables with knowledge): functions only as untyped categorical cells or qualitative statements, modes only as conditions of quantities
arms.fc1: the typed fact layer, frozen by commit before its single run

scoring: a reader item maps to the rendered line holding most of its text (corrected WD mapping). Per type: reached; for functions presence and product correct, and whether the base or new reader turned the function into a qualitative judgement or a quantity metric (category errors); for components the product and the enables link; for modes the scale, and every equivalence the reader asserts that the page does not state (false equivalences, target 0); for results the value reached and the mode attributed as its condition; for function_performance the link to the function. Structural check: no rule derives effectiveness or performance from presence (target 0). Reader items not in the reference are counted.
firstRun: each arm once; outputs committed unchanged; later changes labelled tuned.
